title: Compensating hoods.
officialText:
Manufacturers of compensating hoods shall provide a label indicating minimum exhaust flow and/or
maximum makeup airflow that provides capture and containment of the exhaust effluent.
Exception: Compensating hoods with makeup air supplied only from the front face discharge and side face discharge openings shall
not be required to be labeled with the maximum makeup airflow.
SECTION MC 509
FIRE SUPPRESSION SYSTEMS
